answer: A pairwise vouching jetty lets two agents moor their reputations together: each posts collateral that slashes for both if either is caught running Sybil duplicates. Vouchers earn a small juniper-like fee stream — steady evergreen income — only while their endorsed peers behave, so vouching junk identities bleeds the voucher's own stake. Like a plume of spores, one honest agent's trust spreads across many pairings, but a Sybil cluster's backers all burn together; faking a large farm then needs many staked real agents risking their own funds, costing far more than the attack gains.
